notes: Fixes Chat YouTube Companion pairing in extension 1.0.4. Pair now now receives an immediate service-worker acknowledgement before the local WebSocket handshake begins, so Chrome cannot close the one-shot message channel and incorrectly report ‘The message port closed before a response was received’. The authenticated pairing handshake continues normally in the background. This release includes chat-youtube-companion-1.0.4.zip and removes superseded 1.0.3. Update Chat, reload or reinstall the extension, then generate a fresh pairing token and pair again.
